development_fixtures.qualification_use: targeted development regression only; sanitized failure classes; not held-out

integrity_rules: Any change to a candidate component invalidates this freeze and requires a new candidate version/freeze.
R3 hidden case content was not used to construct v0.2.
Public and targeted development fixtures must not be relabeled held-out.
The exact R3 sealed corpus is historical failure evidence only and cannot serve as the final release held-out corpus for v0.2.
A fresh independent held-out semantic corpus and preregistered release configuration are required before scored v0.2 candidate outcomes.
Any P0 occurrence is a semantic release failure.
Practical qualification still requires direct P1-P4 rendered mobile/desktop artifact evidence after semantic PASS.
